### Implementation note

Pydantic v2's default smart-union mode left known verbs as plain `str` (because `StandardAction` is a `str` subclass — both arms matched). Switching to `union_mode="left_to_right"` makes the enum arm win, satisfying the "coerce to enum on parse" requirement while keeping unknown strings as passthrough.

### Spotify auth flow caveat

Documented in `drivers/README.md` under "Spotify OAuth — first-run setup". If auth fails, the driver logs and falls back to mock mode rather than crashing.
